bhi.config.category.head: Over-head Bar
bhi.config.track_attacked.tip: After attacking a mob, keep showing it during the tracking window even if your crosshair moves away (applies to the Looking At mode and the screen panel).
bhi.config.attack_tracking_seconds.tip: How long an attacked target keeps showing; the timer resets on each hit and stops tracking once it expires.
bhi.config.hide_vanilla_damage_particles: Hide the vanilla heart particles that burst on attack hits, avoiding visual conflict with this mod's own particles.
bhi.config.show_health_text.tip: When on, appends the current/max health value on the name line; when off, mobs with multiple bars show an "x multiplier" there instead.
bhi.config.detail_beside_bar.tip: On: the bar count (x N) / health value sits to the right of the hearts (hearts stay centered). Off: appended after the name with a "|".
bhi.config.head_heart_hit_effect.tip: On damage/heal: white outline blink on the heart container + hearts scatter and tilt.
bhi.config.low_health_shake_threshold.ti: When health <= this ratio of max, the heart row trembles; applies to both over-head bar and panel. 0 disables.
bhi.config.hide_vanilla_name_tag.tip: Hide the vanilla floating name (player names, name-tagged mobs, etc.) to avoid duplicate/overlapping names; entities without a custom bar are unaffected.
bhi.config.text_scale.tip: Name text size relative to the vanilla name tag; 1.0 is vanilla size.
bhi.config.health_text_scale.tip: Health value size relative to the vanilla name tag; lower it to distinguish from the name.
bhi.config.text_bold.tip: When on, the text is rendered in bold.
bhi.config.y_offset.tip: Extra height above the entity model's top; 0 sits on the highest point, positive raises it, negative lowers it.
bhi.config.damage_particles_enabled.tip: On damage, burst dropping heart particles from the corresponding heart position.
bhi.config.particle_shake_scale.tip: Overall strength of the dropping hearts' shake/jitter; 0 disables the shake.
bhi.config.particle_medium_damage.tip: A single hit >= this value enters medium shake.
bhi.config.particle_heavy_damage.tip: A single hit > this value enters heavy tier: stronger spring plus jitter.
bhi.config.container_shatter_enabled.tip: On death, the heart containers shake then chain-shatter one by one; flashy, can be turned off.
bhi.config.tier_color.tip: Main color of bar row %s (used when the mob has multiple bars).
bhi.config.panel_frame_shape.tip: The frame of the 3D model viewport in the panel: square or round.
bhi.config.panel_theme.tip: Light: vanilla off-white style. Dark: translucent dark-glass style.
bhi.config.panel_bar_style.tip: Solid rectangular bar, or vanilla heart icons.
bhi.config.panel_heart_highlight.tip: In heart style, blink the heart container outline white when the target takes damage/heals (vanilla hit feedback).
bhi.config.panel_show_effects.tip: A row of the target's potion effect icons below the bar. Note: vanilla does not sync non-player mob effects to clients, so this only works in singleplayer / your own LAN world; it won't work for other mobs on third-party servers.
bhi.config.panel_text_bold.tip: When on, the panel text is rendered in bold.
bhi.modmenu.cloth_required: Cloth Config is required to open the graphical settings screen. You can still edit config/better_health_indicator.json manually.
